## Summary

Step B of the split from #52103, built on merged #63695.

- Build complete-chunk `BlockStored` payloads from the request carried by the raw store event and the existing key position in `ReqContext`. Partial tails still use the current metadata snapshot.
- Keep the existing block-granular `BlockRemoved` expansion from saved metadata. Chunk-key removals are deferred so this PR does not change the removal contract for downstream consumers.
- The previous delayed-request-status patch has been dropped; this PR does not change transfer-job or request-status handling.

## Scope

This remains draft. #59599 aligns block extra keys and should land before this is finalized. Follow-ups will handle partial tails and, with downstream coordination, chunk-key removals.

## Validation

- On GPU Server, the event/scheduler run passed 521 tests. Three partial-tail/EAGLE tests failed; these do not exercise the removal change and were previously confirmed to fail on unchanged main.
- Pre-commit passed on the three files changed by the removal rollback.

- [x] Relevant tests and pre-commit run
- [x] DCO sign-off
- [ ] Human author review of this rewritten diff before marking ready

Codex assisted with implementation and tests.

Claude:
When a store is built from `req_context` and there's no saved snapshot, save it in `_pending_event_metadata` with the event's residency bit if `removal_expected` is set, and set `removal_expected=True` on the CPU manager's store events.
Otherwise `BlockStored` announces all N block hashes but the later `BlockRemoved` names only the chunk key, so consumers keep N−1 hashes they never see removed.
